conf.description: entra-id signin dataset, json format: parsing deferred entirely to the Azure Logs integration (azure.signinlogs data stream). Thin pipeline: filters the shared Event Hub feed down to the four sign-in diagnostic categories, preserves the raw AADSTS status code the integration's own event.outcome derivation discards, and tags event.dataset.

conf.comment: entra-id / signin / json: SignInLogs, NonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, ServicePrincipalSignInLogs and ManagedIdentitySignInLogs share one Event Hub and one JSON envelope, distinguished only by the top-level category field. Parsing is left to the Azure Logs integration (azure.signinlogs) -- do not re-implement the field mapping it already owns. The only field-table transform actionable pre-Elasticsearch is preserving the raw AADSTS status code alongside the integration's derived event.outcome.

functions.description: document scope: thin pass-through, integration owns ECS mapping
identify the event: keep only the four sign-in diagnostic categories carried on this shared Event Hub feed
preserve the raw AADSTS status code (properties.status.errorCode) for lookup-based failure triage, and tag event.dataset ahead of the integration's own parsing
